name: icon
title: Icon
purpose: Render one individually imported Lucide component through Balsa sizing, stroke, color inheritance, and accessibility semantics.
accessibility: Decorative icons are aria-hidden and not focusable.
A labelled icon uses role=img and aria-label.
Icon-only interactive controls name the owning control; their icon normally remains decorative.
commonMistakes: Passing a string instead of a Lucide component.
Loading the complete dynamic Lucide map.

examples.title: Decorative
examples.description: An unlabelled symbol inherits color and stays hidden from assistive technology.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Icon from "@/components/ui/Icon.vue";
import { Search } from "@lucide/vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Icon :icon="Search" size="md" :stroke-width="2" />
</template>

examples.title: Labelled image
examples.description: Add a label only when the standalone symbol itself conveys content.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Icon from "@/components/ui/Icon.vue";
import { CircleHelp } from "@lucide/vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Icon :icon="CircleHelp" size="lg" :stroke-width="1.5" label="Help" />
</template>
